subject: Follow-up: MAP security milestone & SOC 2 artifacts (Aurelia Tech)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft + SOC 2 package delivery (Aurelia Tech)

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the remaining milestones to get to a production POC. Highlighting the security milestone you asked about (SOC 2 package / evidence):

MAP milestone: Security review + SOC 2 package delivery
- Target: Provide questionnaire and evidence bundle for your security team to review
- Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole (sales PM) and Rishi Malhotra (security lead)
- Owner (Aurelia): Sara Hayes / Procurement (procurement@aurelia-tech.com)
- Deliverables: SOC 2 questionnaire (completed where allowed), evidence checklist + artifacts (sanitized logs, policy docs, SOC 2 report excerpt), access instructions for audit portal
- Target due date: 2026-06-30 (we suggested) — let us know if you need an earlier date
- Dependencies: Legal review of SOW (DocuSign), redaction review for any PII in evidence, your internal security intake form

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Package_v1.zip (contains: SOC2_summary.pdf, SOC2_report-excerpt.pdf, infra-diagram.png, roles_policies.pdf, contact-list.csv)

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm primary security contact and preferred evidence format (discrete docs vs single bundle).
2) Redwood to deliver the completed questionnaire + checklist by 2026-06-30.
3) Schedule a 30-45 minute walkthrough if requested (week of 6/29).

I added the HubSpot MAP link here for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567890

Thanks — looping in Rishi to confirm evidence timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft + SOC 2 package delivery (Aurelia Tech)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the MAP. A few clarifying items from our security team: they prefer discrete documents rather than a single zip for ingestion into our portal. Also they asked for a completed SOC 2 questionnaire (we'll intake it into our tracker) and an evidence spreadsheet that maps each control to a file/restatement.

Couple of asks:
- Can you send the SOC 2 questionnaire as a .docx with answers filled in where we should expect Redwood to provide a response?
- Can you provide an evidence checklist mapping (control ID -> artifact filename) and estimated delivery dates per artifact?

Target date 6/30 works provided we get the questionnaire and checklist by 6/28 so we have time to triage internally. If that timeline is tight, let us know.

Sara Hayes
Senior Security Program Manager
Aurelia Tech

Thanks Sara — good note on format. I've attached the specific files below and broken out delivery commitments:

Deliverables we are sending now (attached):
- SOC2_Questionnaire_Aurelia.docx — completed where possible; items requiring evidence are marked with "(evidence required)" and reference the Evidence Checklist ID.
- Evidence_Checklist_Aurelia.xlsx — maps control IDs -> artifact names + owner + ETA

Commitments / ETA:
- Questionnaire & checklist: delivered 2026-06-29 (today)
- Full evidence bundle (documents/links): 2026-06-30 by EOD (Rishi to deliver most artifacts)
- If Aurelia requests a walkthrough, we can schedule a 30-minute session the week of 6/29 — propose 6/30 10:00 AM PT.

Dependencies we are tracking:
- Legal signoff on SOW / minor terms (DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCDEF-12345) — this needs to be completed to enable certain artifact sharing.
- Redaction review: some logs/screenshots will require PII removal prior to sharing (Rishi flagged).

I've attached the two files as requested (separate docs). If procurement needs a PO or specific contract clause before we share full evidence, flag that and we'll coordinate with legal.

Best,
Marissa
